plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1895 & 1 Apr 1925 (Ernest Overton discovers the lipid permeability barrier; Evert Gorter & François Grendel measure the 2:1 red-blood-cell lipid monolayer on water, proving the phospholipid bilayer) · Feb 1957 & 18 Feb 1972 (Jens Christian Skou isolates the Na+/K+-ATPase sodium-potassium pump from 25,000 crabs, winning the 1997 Nobel Prize; Jonathan Singer & Garth Nicolson propose the Fluid Mosaic Model) · 9 Oct 1991 / 17 Apr 1992 (Peter Agre & Gregory Preston prove CHIP28 / Aquaporin-1 is the cellular water channel via exploding frog oocytes, winning the 2003 Nobel Prize).

teach_overlay.label: 1895–2003 CELL MEMBRANE TIMELINE · SOAP DISRUPTION OF VIRAL ENVELOPES & BANGHAM 1964 SYNTHETIC LIPOSOMES
teach_overlay.detail: Animated timeline (1895 → 2003) alongside an inked diagram of amphiphilic soap molecules prying apart viral lipid envelopes and synthetic two-molecule liposomes encapsulating cargo
teach_overlay.scale: from a silk thread on a water trough in Leiden to twenty-five thousand shore crabs in Denmark and six exploding frog eggs in Baltimore, scientists proved that the two-molecule skin around every cell is a living, breathing border gate
